description.value: Burnaby Village Museum is a 10-acre immersive open-air history museum set within Deer Lake Park, depicting a BC pioneer village as it may have appeared around the turn of the 20th century. The site features heritage buildings, a restored interurban tram, and a working antique carousel, and has grown from its 1971 origins into a free, award-winning attraction that draws visitors from across the Lower Mainland. A touring cyclist would find it a pleasant park-side destination with an on-site café and rich local history.
